pr_title: [3.x] Fix emitting duplicate edges for convex hulls

issue_context.title: Performance issue in GodotPhysics
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

3.4-beta4

### System information

OS: ubuntu 18.04

### Issue description

There is a performance issue in GodotPhysics that seems doesn't exist in v3.3.2-stable. Bullet is OK in both versions.

Godot v3.3.2-stable:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5120436/130202793-30236392-5f72-4b3e-8e55-d08129d7de41.mp4

Godot v3.4-beta4:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5120436/130203150-b64ebdd4-054a-4256-a338-609364c62b35.mp4

Bullet:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5120436/130203774-4a44fa0e-8c6e-4053-b067-8f655aa2eb1b.mp4


### Steps to reproduce

Run the attached project.
If textures doesn't show, select QodotMap node, select "addons/qodot/example_scenes/1-interactivity/1-brush-entities/1-brush-entities.map" in Map File property and press "Full Build" button.

![Screenshot from 2021-08-20 13-02-49](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5120436/130205108-35735398-5edf-43bb-aaec-e9f93160b9f5.png)


### Minimal reproduction project

[GodotPhysicsIssue.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/7020265/GodotPhysicsIssue.zip)

review_comments: To be perfectly safe, it would be nice to add an error in case `edge_copied` didn't fit the vector so it wouldn't cause memory corruption if it happened.
